course_name_original: Design and Economy of Power Plants
course_name_en: Design and Economy of Power Plants
syllabus_topics: Basic stages of investing activities and designing
Basic economical principles (time value, discounting, reproduction, depreciation, cash flow calculation)
Classification of profit and costs in power generation
Criteria for appreciation of economical efficiency (NPV, IRR, payback period) and application in the process of project assessment
Selection of optimal project variant, sensitivity and risk analysis
Base problems of power plant design (location, optimum capacity)
Optimization of fossil fuel and nuclear power plants parameters
degree: Oferta Erasmus+ en inglés de la Fac. de Ingeniería Mecánica (sin plan de grado atado)
